translations.web: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.
translations.bsb: If a ruler listens to lies, all his officials will be wicked.
translations.kjv: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
translations.asv: If a ruler hearkeneth to falsehood, All his servants are wicked.
